option-a.rationale: Uncertainty need not bar practice, but proximity does not show the tradition mediates truth.

option-a.rationale: The higher power's concern and the nearby tradition's access are unsupported assumptions.

option-b.rationale: It answers doctrinal underdetermination pragmatically but not its metaphysical substance.

option-b.rationale: The move materially supports practice before certainty, a central pro burden.

option-b.rationale: The concession identifies rather than discharges the pro hiddenness burden.

option-b.rationale: The difference between intense experience and its absence is stated clearly.

option-a.rationale: The challenge is candidly acknowledged as powerful and beyond the speaker's knowledge.

option-b.rationale: The speaker fairly grants why recipients believe and why others remain unconvinced.

option-b.rationale: It answers why no universal map exists but leaves the dilemma's sufficiency horn open.

option-b.rationale: Freedom, journey, and settled revelation are understandable but not sharply defined.

option-b.rationale: The speaker uses may and probably, although also treats the world as a given.

option-b.rationale: Hiddenness predicts unexplained appearances only if the disputed framework is assumed.

option-a.rationale: The proposed compatibility matters, but possibility alone weakly supports divine goodness.
